notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello! It’s been a while.
We are working hard to prepare for the official release.
The main content of the official version will be [b]World Tour[/b].

World Tour is an exciting adventure where you’ll travel through various maps, exploring 40 thrilling stages!
You’ll be able to experience World Tour in the official version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/06fc93d795d4559f386e3dfed729c350bab20764.png[/img]

We’ll continue sharing updates on new content.
Thank you!

notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:

We’ve made several changes to allow you to try out more diverse strategies!

[b]<New Additions>[/b]
[list]
[*]5 new souvenirs have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/18f46d11123beb3d3c8c9b62c89763fb040a8166.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/8899b79819315dea6d56ada24e3a93783605c0e0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/1d2f5c5e8e123f37fcbbdd272e017cb5019ec51f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/7f8402593db27f74fa653dbf5dfa28f74671042e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/5c02d65ee1dfe3eb5e9fcc231b1ee700c4bc64f7.png[/img]

[*] A new gem trinket that provides energy has been added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/daca859046b59e01cedcd77dd4cbf22e7c1e7afc.png[/img]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/71418f271667c14b679e7f6b51a4de2f7e5ff47a.png[/img][b]<Changes>[/b]
[list]
[*]Ban trinket removed [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/5b4ec391006df27dd7cf8c7ab7b4776065971d56.png[/img]

[*]Steel Upgrade removed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/58bd7b7bf7e8989e39466c429b46eb4cacc3fc17.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/b7984e867d0df3db594acca13653bd517c7b6fa5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/90aa61798c64ce8c29aac811eb52f7bb50643c35.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/8659b9cbfd14b098eb1aff6cb4d707719c72d78d.png[/img]

[*]Souvenir changes
Now, most souvenirs can be obtained [b]in duplicates[/b]!

[*]Stair trinket changes
Stair decorations now reset from [b]6 to 1[/b] when rerolled.

[*]Difficulty adjustment in Infinite Mode

Tooltips, enhancement level displays, and other features have been improved for easier understanding.

[b]-The leaderboards will be reset.
-Save records will be deleted.[/b]

That’s all we’ve prepared for this time!
Duck N Roll will continue to evolve! Stay tuned!

notes.title: The massive update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/71418f271667c14b679e7f6b51a4de2f7e5ff47a.png[/img]
Hello!
The massive update patch has finally been applied!
We have made various changes to provide a more enjoyable game and a thrilling experience.
Now you can feel the fun of a new game!
We hope you enjoy it again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/be02d303c5ed03fae69be202a75270f309395e02.gif[/img]

<Changes>
-Hand ranks
  Now, a straight can be made with 4 dice!
  However, it only attacks the designated target twice.
  If the target falls on the first attack, the second attack is cancelled!

-Dice usage method
  Remaining dice in your bag can now be used all in your turn.
  You can now attack twice in a row!

-Dice effects
  Glass dice now deal area damage as they break.
  The clown trinkets receives an effect when rerolled into a chain trinkets.

-Dice face change reward
  Dice faces can no longer be changed, but it will be more fun that way!

-Battle rewards, bonus rewards
 The list of rewards has been expanded.

-Mini-game
  A mini-game has been added where you can choose good rewards if you roll the dice well!

-Souvenir
  Hot sauce souvenir has been removed.

-Leaderboard reset

-Save records deleted

Oh, everyone! Duck N Roll is currently participating in the Busan Indie Connect Festival!
We are constantly striving to bring you fun.
Please also show interest in the BIC event!

notes.title: Participation in BIC and Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Our team is constantly looking for ways to make your adventure more enjoyable. To ensure that you are not disappointed with Duck and Roll, we are preparing various changes, including updates to characters, stages, and the dice system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/ae82a81c79f0db2719b4dfda10b64417c55f4485.jpg[/img]

Oh! [b]Duck and Roll[/b] is currently participating in the [b]Busan Indie Connect Festival[/b]! With the start of this year's BIC event,

there will be many changes in the [b]patch on August 9th[/b]! Get ready for a stronger and more thrilling [b]Duck and Roll[/b] experience!
